mechanisms.title: Schedule Line Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: Item category says what the item is. Schedule line says how quantity moves.
failure_proof: no requirement/ATP → item category + MRP type → schedule line → requirements/availability flags
no delivery relevance → prove schedule-line delivery relevance

mechanisms.title: Delivering Plant Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: Plant is a small field with an absurd amount of downstream authority.
failure_proof: wrong ATP/intercompany → prove plant and its source first
shipping point missing → prove plant before shipping-point combination

mechanisms.title: Shipping Point Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: Plant says where supply lives. Shipping point says who executes shipping.
failure_proof: shipping point missing → plant + shipping condition + loading group + determination entry
delivery split → compare shipping point and other split-relevant delivery criteria

mechanisms.title: Route Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: Route turns geography and service level into time.
failure_proof: wrong route → departure zone + shipping condition + transportation group + destination zone + delivery weight group
dates shift → compare scheduling before/after route

mechanisms.title: Delivery & Transportation Scheduling
mechanisms.memory_hook: Route turns distance into duration. Scheduling turns duration into dates.
output: confirmed delivery date when forward scheduled
failure_proof: late confirmation → isolate transit + transport lead + loading + pick/pack + calendars + forward scheduling
stock available but date not confirmed → prove logistics dates, not only inventory

mechanisms.title: ATP / aATP Product Availability
mechanisms.memory_hook: A requested date is a wish. A confirmed schedule line is the system's promise.
failure_proof: stock visible but no confirmation → plant + checking group/rule + scope + stock segment + competing requirements
order/delivery differ → compare checking rules and scope

mechanisms.title: Batch Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: The material answers what. Batch determination answers which exact stock.
mechanisms.debug_path: search procedure → strategy type → strategy key → selection class/characteristics → batch classification → availability → sort rule → quantity proposal
